source.title: Tree-level scattering amplitudes in nonlocal field theories

theorem_domain.action_class: S = S_loc + E_i F_ij E_j with analytic/weakly-nonlocal operators and the stated EOM-based construction
theorem_domain.gravity_specialization: nonlocal gravity without the material Riemann^2 form-factor branch covered by the field-redefinition equivalence
theorem_domain.comparator: underlying local theory; for gravity, Einstein GR
theorem_domain.result: all on-shell n-point tree-level amplitudes coincide with the local comparator within theorem scope
theorem_domain.asymptotic_state_statement: the perturbative spectra and asymptotic-state Hilbert spaces coincide within theorem scope

scope_exclusions: Riemann^2-form-factor branches for which the cited tree equivalence statement is not automatically inherited
generic loop-level amplitudes not closed by the tree theorem
off-shell Green functions and bare form-factor shape diagnostics
material non-scattering observables not reduced by the theorem
